Summary
: This essay studies the Kamashastra—the discipline of Kama (sensual pleasure) and the available Sanskrit literature belonging this genre, such as the Kamasutra of Vatsyayana from the 4th century. This study focusses on the vision of life of ancient India reflected in the Kamashastra. Another topic of discussion is the philosopical standpoint, which presents Kama-Shastra as a materialistic path leading to Moksha (liberation).
